name: Black Box Ltd.
about: Black Box Limited provides information and communications technology solutions in India, the United States, and internationally. It operates through System Integration, Technology Product Solution, and Others segments. The company offers enterprise networking, data centers, digital workplace, connected buildings, and cyber security products; keyboard, video and mouse (KVM), cables, Internet of Things (IoT), and audio video products; and IP-led hardware and software offerings, including KVM switches, OEM-distributed equipment, and contract-manufactured solutions. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 12.9% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 63 vs sector median 25; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 23, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 95% a year while PE moved 102 → 63.
